text:
kai: @channel quick PSA — release cutoff in ~48h. Small changelog asks to make the final pass easier for the release lead :wave:
- Keep entries short (1–2 lines), present-tense verbs (e.g., "Adds", "Fixes", not "Added").
- Include ticket/PR link at end like `(PR #4321)` or link to the PR.
- Add a component tag if relevant: `component: runtime / console / infra`.
- Avoid internal-only notes (ops playbooks, internal links) — those can go in the PR body.
If you can quickly check your outstanding PRs and update entries, that would be huge :memo:
Example: `Adds adaptive batching to reduce tail latency (PR #4321) — runtime`

release-bot: :bell: Release cutoff scheduled in 48 hours (2026-03-19T16:00Z). Please update changelog entries by then.

maria: Thanks — quick question: how strict are we on the `component:` label? Is `infra` ok for deduping?
samir: @maria yes — infra/runtime/console are what we use. If unsure pick the closest and we can refine during curation.
abby: Ping — I have two open PRs (4321, 4389). I'll tidy entries tonight. Do we prefer PR number or short link?
leo: PR number is fine in the one-liner. Full link is optional.
abb y: (typo) — actually meant "abby" :grimacing:
abby: ^^ fixed — thanks :sweat_smile:
maria: Also, small formatting nit: can we keep bullet punctuation consistent? either all sentences or no trailing period. tiny, but it reads nicer. :mag:
samir: Volunteer to own the changelog for the runtime component — I'll do a pass after cutoff and merge any tiny edits.
kai: Awesome, thanks. If you can't update an entry, drop `needs-owner` in the PR title and tag me. We'll try not to ship ambiguous one-liners.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder set — 24h and 1h before cutoff.
leo: Quick linter idea — could we add a CI check for `(PR #\d+)` or `component:` presence? low effort and high value.
kai: Good idea. @eng-infra can we add a lightweight check for presence of PR/issue reference in changelog entries? Not blocking for this cutoff but would help.
abby: Done for my PRs. thanks all :thumbsup:
samir: will start curation pass in ~2 hours.
kai: Thanks team — short tidy up and we'll be set for the release :rocket:
